_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Camouflage Line Art Data
summary: Camouflage Line Art Data provides the Government with technical information used in the development of camouflage patterns.
use_relationship:
Camouflage Line Art Data provides the Government with technical information to be used in the development of camouflage patterns.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) identifies the format and content requirement covered by the specific and discrete task for the contractor to prepare this data product as identified in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
b. This DID contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.
c. This DID supersedes DI-MISC-80176A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Contract.
preparation_instructions.content: This data is generated by the contract which contains a specific and discrete work task to develop this data product.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Camouflage Line Art Data shall be prepared on approximately 22 inch width X 34 inch length paper to a scale of 1/8 inch for items with an overall length of 25 feet or less and 1/10 inch scale for items of more than 25 feet.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Separate Camouflage Line Art Data shall be prepared depicting each of the following views: a. front b. back c. top d. right side e. left side f. all hidden views (hidden views are those areas requiring camouflage coloration that are not apparent from the other views. Included are variations in the appearance of the item that result when the deployed item is taken from a standby condition and placed into a ready-for-use or use condition).

children.title: All Camouflage Line Art Data shall include length, width, and height dimensions relative to each other.
children.content: Shall be detailed to the extent that all surface features of the item that cover one square inch or more of area are clearly delineated to scale.

children.title: The right lower corner of each sheet of Camouflage Line Art Data shall contain the following information:
children.content: a. Nomenclature of the item depicted. b. View depicted. c. Number of the contract under which the Line Art is furnished.
